 🚨 Barcola, Isak: Iraola makes 4 changes to his XI for Liverpool-Brighton 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Liverpool return to Premier League action this afternoon as they welcome an in-form Brighton side.
 Liverpool FC 2 Brighton & Hove Albion 0 46' The Reds have come from behind to win their last two matches, first against Brentford last weekend. In the Champions League in midweek, they found themselves two goals down against Villarreal before eventually winning 4-3 at Anfield.
 OneFootball Videos
 Brighton, meanwhile, drew 0-0 in the Conference League in midweek, but last week's 5-0 win over rivals Crystal Palace sent a serious warning to the rest of the league.
 Here's how both teams line up on Merseyside...
 The Reds to take on Brighton ✊🔴 #LIVBHA  –  Sunday, 25 October 2026 
 Liverpool : Alisson ; Araújo, Jacquet, Van Dijk, Kerkez; Gravenberch, Mac Allister; Barcola, Wirtz, Gakpo; Isak.
 Four changes for Iraola's side. Milos Kerkez returns in defence, with Bradley Barcola , Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz all starting.
 Brighton : Verbruggen; Kadioglu, Dunk, Vuskovic, Boscagli; Gross, Chema Andrés ; Diego Gómez, Ayari, De Cuyper; Kostoulas.
 Who will come out on top?
